intro: These guidelines help partners, volunteers, and hub coordinators represent Seattle Emergency Hubs consistently. Please follow the usage rules below when using our logos, colors, or photos in print, digital, or promotional materials.

logos.name: Primary Logo
logos.description: Full-color logo for white or light-colored backgrounds. This is the preferred version for most applications.

logos.name: Reversed Logo
logos.description: Full-color logo adjusted for dark backgrounds such as the site footer color (#1a2e3a).

logos.name: Circle Mark
logos.description: Square icon for social media profile images, favicons, and small-format uses where the full logotype is not legible.

logos.name: One-Color Black
logos.description: Single-color version for black-and-white printing, faxes, photocopies, and engraving.

logos.name: One-Color White
logos.description: Single-color version for dark backgrounds, photographs, and merchandise printed on dark fabric.

colors.name: Navy Blue
colors.note: Headlines, print materials, and large brand areas.

colors.name: Hub Blue
colors.note: Used for links, buttons, and headings on this website.

colors.name: Forest Green
colors.note: Positive actions, confirmations, and supporting accents.

colors.name: Signal Orange
colors.note: Highlights and calls to attention. Use sparingly.

colors.name: Light Grey
colors.note: Default page background in light mode.

fonts.note: Falls back to system-ui / Segoe UI where Noto Sans is unavailable.

fonts.sample: Community preparedness starts neighbor by neighbor. Our hubs provide training, resources, and connection so every Seattle neighborhood can respond together when disaster strikes.
fonts.note: Noto Sans is free to download and use in print and document materials.

usageDo: Use the provided logo files without modification
Maintain clear space around the logo equal to the height of the icon mark
Use the reversed logo on dark backgrounds
Use Navy Blue or Forest Green as dominant brand colors
Credit Seattle Emergency Hubs when reproducing materials
Credit the individual photographer when using a contributed photo
Contact us before using the logo in partnership materials or press
usageDont: Stretch, skew, or otherwise distort the logo
Change logo colors or apply gradients or drop shadows
Place the logo on a busy photographic background without a clear field
Use the logo to imply official endorsement without permission
Recreate the logo in a different typeface or icon
Use Signal Orange as a background color for large areas of text
Use contributed photos in commercial or political advertising
